name: button
title: Button
description: A button with seven visual variants and four sizes, built on a native button element with an optional asChild slot for links.
author: Design From <https://labs.designfrom.com>

props.name: variant
props.description: Selects the variant styles defined by buttonVariants.

props.name: size
props.description: Selects the size styles defined by buttonVariants.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Render the single child element instead of the default element, merging props onto it (Radix Slot).

a11y: Renders a native button with type="button" by default, so Enter and Space activate it and it never submits a form by accident.
Focus is always visible through a 3px ring in the ring color.
Disabled buttons ignore pointer events and dim to 50% opacity; explain why nearby when the reason is not obvious.
The press scale is skipped under prefers-reduced-motion.
